rules.title: 15 October 2021: Delhi’s special testing requirement
rules.body: For this direct Delhi–Canada shift, require a negative molecular result from Genestrings Laboratory at Delhi airport, sampled no more than 18 hours before scheduled departure. A fresh antigen result or a different credible clinic does not satisfy this route-specific requirement. Do not substitute the general 72-hour rule.

rules.title: Read the collection time and its UTC offset
rules.body: Count elapsed hours from specimen collection to the scheduled flight departure, including the stated time-zone offsets. The report’s issue time does not restart the window. Exactly 18 hours is within the limit. An unreadable or missing offset must be clarified when it could change the answer.

sources.publisher: Public Safety Canada / CBSA historical timeline

rules.title: Rapid PCR and rapid antigen are different
rules.body: Molecular testing includes the RT-PCR and rapid PCR methods used in these cases. “Rapid” alone does not identify the test type. Antigen and antibody results are not substitutes for this molecular requirement; an unresolved methodology conflict needs verification.

sources.publisher: Public Safety Canada / CBSA historical timeline

rules.title: Check the designated laboratory and collection site
rules.body: The approved laboratory for the authored direct route is Genestrings at Delhi airport. A genuine, accredited result from another clinic does not establish compliance. Distinguish a confirmed different provider from an unresolved conflict about which site issued the report.

sources.publisher: Public Safety Canada / CBSA historical timeline

rules.title: Vaccination does not supply the required test
rules.body: For these non-exempt adults, the historical direct-flight test requirement still applies when fully vaccinated. Canadian citizenship and a completed ArriveCAN submission do not replace the test. Prior-positive and other exemptions are explicitly excluded from this authored cohort.

rules.title: Finish the available checks before the final call
rules.body: Air Beluga fictional training procedure: request an available replacement report before refusing for an unusable one. Deny a confirmed unmet requirement after the offered alternatives are exhausted. Escalate a material time, method or issuer conflict that remains unresolved after the available verification. This desk procedure is a game rule, not a government escalation mandate.
